_comment: 8 rooms. Level modifiers are NOT cumulative: each level lists the full active set. upgradeCosts = [L1->L2, L2->L3]. Office starts built at L1 (buildCost 0).

rooms.description: A cramped projection booth turned HQ: the job board, the desk, and a fence crate under a dust sheet.

levels.effectText: Job board shows 3 productions. Fence crate sells basic gear. 2 gear slots per crew member.
levels.flavour: One desk lamp, one ashtray, one dream.

levels.effectText: Job board shows 4 productions.
levels.flavour: A second filing cabinet. You're practically a studio.

levels.effectText: Job board shows 5 productions.
levels.flavour: Leather chair, brass nameplate, a phone with three lines and a hold button.

rooms.description: Bunks, a bar, a pool table with a lean.

levels.effectText: Roster cap 6. Idle crew +1 loyalty/night.
levels.flavour: Somebody already carved their initials in the bar.

levels.effectText: Roster cap 8. Idle crew +1 loyalty/night.
levels.flavour: A jukebox that only plays one song. Everyone loves that song.

levels.effectText: Roster cap 10. Idle crew +2 loyalty/night.
levels.flavour: Velvet booths and a neon sign that says OPEN even when you're very much closed.

rooms.description: The old prop department: lathes, paint cans and a pegboard of things that are definitely not weapons.

levels.effectText: 3rd gear slot. Tier-2 gear in the catalogue.
levels.flavour: Props, costumes, gadgets. Strictly for the production.

levels.effectText: 3rd gear slot. Tier-3 gear in the catalogue.
levels.flavour: A welding rig and a man named Sparks who doesn't talk about the eyebrows.

levels.effectText: 3rd gear slot. Tier-3 gear. All gear 20% cheaper.
levels.flavour: You've cut out the middleman. The middleman is now in the Lounge.

rooms.description: The loading dock, with a roller door and an oil stain shaped like a getaway.

levels.effectText: Run 2 crews per night. Unlocks heavy jobs. +4% success with a Wheelman on the crew.
levels.flavour: Two cars, one roller door, zero parking tickets.

levels.effectText: Run 3 crews per night. Heavy jobs. +4% success with a Wheelman.
levels.flavour: A hydraulic lift and a calendar nobody admits to hanging.

levels.effectText: Run 4 crews per night. Heavy jobs. +4% success with a Wheelman.
levels.flavour: A whole fleet. Every car has a name, a favourite song and a fake licence plate.

rooms.description: The old auditorium: torn velvet seats, a silver screen and a projector that still purrs.

levels.effectText: 1 retake per night: re-roll a failed heist. Unlocks the Final Cut.
levels.flavour: Let's go again from the top. And this time, with feeling.

levels.effectText: 1 retake per night. Final Cut. +1 Luck for the whole crew.
levels.flavour: Re-upholstered front row. The Director's seat has cup holders.

levels.effectText: 2 retakes per night. Final Cut. +1 Luck for the whole crew.
levels.flavour: Restored marquee, red curtains, and a standing ovation every time someone gets home.

rooms.description: The former first-aid room. The doctor's licence is framed. It's framed very loosely.

levels.effectText: Injuries heal twice as fast.
levels.flavour: Bandages, ice packs and a lollipop for the brave.

levels.effectText: Injuries heal twice as fast. Patch up injured crew for $1,500 per night of injury.
levels.flavour: The doc now makes house calls. The house is this one.

levels.effectText: Heal twice as fast. Patch-ups. 25% lower injury chance.
levels.flavour: A proper X-ray machine, a pre-shoot stretching routine, and a strict no-stunts-without-padding policy.

rooms.description: A broom cupboard full of blinking tape reels, humming like a beehive.

levels.effectText: Intel: see exact arrest risk and outcome bands. Hacker jobs pay +20%.
levels.flavour: The police radio codes, on punch cards, alphabetised.

levels.effectText: Intel. Hacker jobs pay +20%. Everyone +5 Tech.
levels.flavour: A second mainframe. It doesn't do anything, but the first one seems happier.

levels.effectText: Intel. Hacker jobs pay +30%. Everyone +8 Tech.
levels.flavour: The whole city's traffic lights, on a dial. Use responsibly.

rooms.description: The old box office, now with a brass plaque and a man who bills by the quarter-minute.

levels.effectText: Bail out arrested crew within 1 night (costs their hire price). Arrest chance -15%.
levels.flavour: Objection! Sustained. Probably.

levels.effectText: Bail at 75% of hire price. Arrest chance -20%.
levels.flavour: A junior partner who went to law school. Night school. It counts.

levels.effectText: Bail at 50% of hire price. Arrest chance -30%.
levels.flavour: The judge plays golf with your lawyer. The judge always loses.
